title: fix: piv_get_sw has no internal guard against resplen < 2
description:
piv_get_sw() in src/wp11_proto_piv.c:129-134 accesses resp[resplen-2] and resp[resplen-1] with no internal bounds check. All 9 callers currently pre-check resplen >= 2 before calling — but this is a silent precondition with no annotation, no assert, and no internal enforcement.

Any future caller that omits the guard (or receives a truncated response from a misbehaving token) will produce a size_t underflow (resplen < 2u → huge index) and an out-of-bounds read.

Fix: Add explicit guard inside piv_get_sw:
  if (resplen < 2u) { *sw1 = 0; *sw2 = 0; return; }  /* caller must detect SW 0000 as invalid */
OR change signature to return int and propagate:
  static int piv_get_sw(...) { if (resplen < 2u) return -1; ... return 0; }
Add a comment at the function definition explaining the precondition and why internal checking is needed even though callers also guard.

This resolves wolfp11work-975.
